text: Cycling, an engaging form of transportation and recreation, utilizes two-wheeled bicycles. To enhance performance and control, various gears are employed. Safety gear, particularly a helmet, is paramount in protecting cyclists from potential accidents. This gear not only safeguards the head but also contributes to overall safety by reducing the risk of head injuries.
summary: Cycling uses two-wheeled, pedaling bikes; gears enhance performance and control; safety gear, like helmets, is crucial for protection.
